concepts.title: G1 · Lodjuret
concepts.direction:
Audience Swedish gymnasiet, older teenagers. Character: original anthro Nordic lynx, dignified slender upper body, long distinctive black ear tufts, short tawny-grey fur, cool graphite cheeks, restrained hazel eyes with normal proportions, cream chin, black nose, short lynx muzzle, subtly angular silhouette. Understated unfastened charcoal overshirt with plain stone-grey collarless shirt, NO hoodie or scarf, no resemblance to current blue fox. Render matte textured 3D editorial character. Calm friendly peer, never stern. Listening ears asymmetrical, speaking one paw open, preparing pencil and small sheet, waiting forepaws rest loosely together.
Screen style graphite science studio: background #15191F, raised card #20262E, text #F0EEE8, muted warm amber #D8B573. No grid. Thin grey borders, 8px corners, flat cards without shadows or glow. Lexend readable sans serif, medium weight headings, no uppercase dashboard labels. Board title "Andragradsfunktioner", a simple clean coordinate graph of y = x² − 4 with vertex at (0,−4) and roots (−2,0),(2,0). One adjacent card "Var skär kurvan x-axeln?" and equation "x² − 4 = 0". Caption "Vi letar där y är noll." Main status "Pratar". Footer note "Lexend · 8 px hörn".
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup and stylized-concept. Create ONE polished portrait-format concept presentation image, ideally 1024x1536 or larger portrait equivalent, for Open Tutor, a Swedish live voice tutor. This is a design proposal, not a marketing poster. Original fictional nonhuman character only; no resemblance to existing game, film, anime or tech mascot franchises. No human learners, photographs, personal names, logos, trademark symbols or copyright characters. Typography must support Swedish å ä ö.

COMPOSITION: Top 8% clear direction title and small URL. Next 43% a complete crisp front-on desktop in-call application mockup, board LEFT ~74%, compact companion RIGHT ~26%, no perspective, no device frame, no browser chrome. Entire application visible including fixed bottom chat control bar. Companion is an isolated figure on the UI background, no room, desk, scenery, classroom or props behind it. Modest header with "Open Tutor", menu at right. Show one understandable worked teaching example on board with generous readable type and restrained active-step accent, one page at a time, tiny back/next page navigation. Caption and status pill below the right companion; main screen shows SPEAKING, with small speech bars ONLY here and under the speaking portrait. Bottom bar contains attachment icon, input "Skriv här om du vill…", microphone button, restrained red "Avsluta". No chat transcript, profile grid, XP or decorative widgets.

Bottom 45% is a generously sized 2 by 2 CHARACTER STATE SHEET of SAME exact character identity, same scale and body framing, clearly different pose in every panel. Each panel has a readable Swedish status pill under it. Top left "Lyssnar": alert engaged eyes directed at viewer, slight head tilt, closed mouth or beak, no waves. Top right "Pratar": visibly open mouth/beak, modest explanatory gesture toward viewer's LEFT, small speech bars. Bottom left "Förbereder tavlan": gaze down and viewer-left toward a small loose sheet, visibly concentrating or sketching, mouth/beak closed, small pencil icon, NO speech bars. Bottom right "Väntar": relaxed upright posture, closed mouth/beak, eyes open and gentle patient expression toward viewer-left, no closed sleepy eyes, small hollow-circle status, absolutely NO voice bars or busy indicator. No repeated subtitles or microtext. Final bottom strip 4% shows four palette swatches with hex codes and one small typography/card note.
Make every state legible in grayscale through silhouette, eye direction and icons, not color alone. Adult/teen proportions and calm self-possession, approachable intelligence. No giant baby eyes, no hats, graduation caps, spectacles, headphones, wings on mammals, clothes on birds, neon glow, hovering decorative particles, shiny plastic robot, smiley blob or hologram. Render premium distinctive illustrated sculptural characters with controlled lighting; flat crisp UI. Board content is illustrative fictional study material. State sheet is OUTSIDE the mock screen.

concepts.title: G2 · Korpen
concepts.direction:
Audience Swedish gymnasiet, older teenagers. Character: original clever corvid companion, long clean slate-black beak and compact angular raven head, expressive warm pale-grey eyes normal sized and small amber iris, graduated ink-indigo layered feather planes on chest, slender mature proportions, subtle asymmetrical feather crest NOT spiky anime hair. No clothing or gadgets. Render beautifully sculpted matte paper/ceramic feather planes with hand-made visual sophistication, not realistic wildlife or cute cartoon baby. Chest-up to midbody. Closed folded bird wings form modest explanatory gestures; no flying. Listening head cocked, speaking beak open and left wing slightly extended, preparing looks down at a small pale sheet supported by one wing, waiting wing tips rest softly together and eyes open. Character faces viewer or viewer-left only.
Screen style ink and lilac studio: background #191923, raised surfaces #252532, text #F1EFF7, restrained lilac #B6A4DE focus, quiet sage for correct results. No grid, no glow. Crisp thin borders, 10px radius flat cards. Lexend sans serif, readable normal-weight labels. Caption "Vi letar där y är noll." Main status "Pratar". Footer note "Lexend · 10 px hörn".

concepts.title: V1 · Hägern
concepts.direction:
Audience adults studying anything from a trade to university. Character: original sculptural grey heron companion with adult long neck curved in a graceful S, long fine charcoal beak, compact narrow head and naturally proportioned amber eye, subtle expressive brow ridge, pale warm limestone feather body with charcoal wing edges and one restrained ochre patch. Neither mascot baby nor ornamental real bird, subtly anthropomorphic hand-sculpted ceramic illustration, approachable, intelligent and present. No clothes, spectacles or academic props. Bust includes long neck and folded wings. Listening head turned attentively to viewer, speaking beak open and one wing subtly turned toward board LEFT, preparing neck curves down to small plain sheet with one wing touching it, waiting comfortable upright S neck and softly folded wings, open eyes. SAME companion all 5 instances.
Screen style warm reading room without any room illustration: LIGHT mineral canvas #F3F0E8, white-paper cards #FFFEFA, dark ink #26342F, restrained forest green #376858. Calm flat editorial layout, fine warm grey rules, 4px corners, no grid, no shadowy stacked cards. Lexend for body and all maths and captions, restrained Georgia-like serif only for main lesson title. UI looks like serious personal learning tool, not banking dashboard or marketing. Board title "Ränta på ränta", prominent equation "K = 10 000 · 1,04⁵", a simple five-step horizontal chart with gently increasing bars, small note "4 % per år · 5 år". Caption "Räntan läggs till varje år." Main status "Pratar". Footer note "Lexend + serifrubrik · 4 px hörn".

concepts.title: V2 · Vecket
concepts.direction:
Audience adults learning any subject. Character: an ORIGINAL abstract folded-material being, a slender upright folded loop of warm terracotta paper-felt, one asymmetrical rounded fold forms a head above a narrow body, two small inset charcoal almond-shaped eyes in the upper fold and a fine crease mouth; recognisably an addressable intelligent companion. Rounded angular folds form two elegant winglike arms without hands, no antenna, screen face, circular robot head or physical stand. Feels like tactile contemporary sculpture with a personality, deliberately NOT a ghost, flame, teardrop, bean, owl, toy robot or existing mascot. One subtle stitched seam, matte paper/felt grain, gentle eyes rather than glowing dots. Medium proportions, narrow shoulders. Listening loop leans subtly toward viewer, crease mouth shut, speaking upper fold opens at the mouth crease and left folded arm gestures viewer-left, preparing head fold bends downward and folded arms hold a small plain cream note sheet, waiting upright and relaxed folded arms rest together. Eyes open except natural blink, no sleepy closed eyelids. Identity and proportions identical in every panel.
Screen style quiet aubergine and linen: DARK background #211E25, raised surfaces #2C2830, text #EFE9DF, muted copper/terracotta accent #D5A080. No grid, no neon, no glass, no gradients. Generous whitespace, 6px radius thin bordered cards, readable Lexend sans serif throughout. Mature editorial workspace rather than corporate analytics. Board title "Ränta på ränta", prominent equation "K = 10 000 · 1,04⁵", a simple five-step horizontal chart with gently increasing bars, small note "4 % per år · 5 år". Caption "Räntan läggs till varje år." Main status "Pratar". Footer note "Lexend · 6 px hörn".
